title: Chapter 499
text:
Although more than half of the Six Nations' forces had been destroyed by the catastrophe, they still managed to maintain their intelligence network. Not long after, this video of the whole process was played in the meeting of the Six Nations' upper echelons. After watching it, all the upper echelons of the Six Nations did not say a word. Their faces were stiff, and the shock was frozen in their eyes.

They had always thought that only Godora would come to save them, but Han Xiao had suddenly appeared with a fleet without any warning. The upper echelons of the Six Nations were stunned.

"Black Phantom is back, and he even brought a space fleet with him?"

He had gone to space two years ago, and there had been no news of him since. They did not expect that not only was Han Xiao still alive, but he also had such unbelievable power. The strength of the mercenaries under his command had shocked the upper echelons of the Six Nations. In their eyes, they only thought that Black Phantom's strength was already at the peak. They did not expect that Han Xiao would bring back hundreds of strong people and more than ten spaceships!

With this strength, it was enough to wipe out the Six Nations!

When Han Xiao had gone to space, they had already been shocked once. The Six Nations also wanted to go to space, but they did not have the hardware to build spaceships. Godora did not respond to their request and could only grit their teeth in envy.

They did not know what Han Xiao had done in space. The upper echelons of the Six Nations only knew one thing — Black Phantom's level was far beyond theirs!

In the past, although Black Phantom had been highly valued by the Six Nations because of his contribution in destroying the Germinal Organization, Black Phantom was still on the same level in their eyes. For example, they were all students in the same class. The Six Nations were good students who always scored above ninety points, and Black Phantom was a top student who always scored full marks. There were good and bad results, but they were all students in the same class.

Now, Black Phantom had become a little genius who skipped grades and was recommended for a master's degree. They were not on the same level at all!

A few days ago, they were still hesitating whether to attack Sanctuary Three. Now, they did not have to worry about this anymore. To be honest, the upper echelons of the Six Nations were relieved.

Luckily, this guy came back in time. If they had not held back before he came back, they would have been wiped out.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations did not dare to have any more thoughts. At the same time, another idea appeared in their minds. Should they ask for Black Phantom's help?

Godora had not arrived yet, but Black Phantom had returned with the fleet. In the eyes of the Six Nations, Han Xiao and Godora were both galactic forces that were far beyond the civilization level of the Blue Star. Furthermore, he was originally from their hometown, so there was an 80% chance that he would help.

Since he could not count on Godora, he might as well try Black Phantom.

…

At the same time, the players in the sanctuary excitedly shared their videos on the forum. The Blue Star section was instantly flooded with comments, and its popularity soared. Black Star's name became a trending topic, and his presence was noticed.

There were different versions of the video, and the perspectives were different. The other Blue Star players who were not present saw Han Xiao enter the stage in different poses, and they were immediately shocked and overjoyed. They understood how the players in the sanctuary felt.

The benefits brought by Han Xiao in Version 1.0 were still fresh in their minds. Now that the version was new, and Han Xiao had returned from the galaxy, he would most likely bring a lot of resources from the new version, which was what they needed the most. What new benefits would Black Star have? Just thinking about it made them excited.

The players who came online from other locations were excited. They immediately put down the missions in their hands and rushed to the sanctuary. The players who were already on the road also sped up.

Mad Blade and the others who were still on the road saw these posts. They could not help but want to return to Han Xiao's side immediately.

Everyone had been following Black Star since Version 1.0. They were clearly the ones who came first.

Pork Bun's video had a wide audience. Players from other novice planets also came to watch and discuss.

"This appearance is quite exciting. I think he has a chance to be selected for the promotion of the new version."

"The Galaxy Times was right. This character has more storyline. It really appeared in Version 2.0."

"I wonder if the others can join the Black Star Mercenary faction, just like those professional players."

Following the discussion, someone made a guess.

"In Version 2.0, every novice planet will be connected to the galaxy. Could it be that Black Star is the guide for Blue Star to enter the galaxy?"

Many people thought about it carefully and came to a realization. Heh, what he said made sense.

There were more than ten spaceships in the sky, and they could bring many people away from the planet.

This guess instantly gained the approval of many people. Many people believed that Han Xiao was the key person for the Blue Star players to enter the galaxy.

…

In the core area of Sanctuary Three, Han Xiao got the mercenaries who knew magic to help him cultivate the materials for the suppressant. With their help, the production of the suppressant would be greatly increased.

Currently, the Mutation Source was still very young, and the effect of the suppressant would only last for about three months. When the Mutation Source entered the next stage, it would require a few doses of the suppressant to achieve the suppressant effect. Thus, resources were still lacking.

Saving the refugees could increase the progress of the mission, and Han Xiao's mission also shared the progress of the players. This was the same for everyone. However, if too many people stayed in Sanctuary Three, not only would it be crowded, it would also cause chaos if the suppressant failed.

Han Xiao did not want too many refugees to stay in Sanctuary Three, but Bennett would definitely not be at ease. The way Han Xiao saw it, the Six Nations had such a large territory, and they would be able to settle many refugees.

Han Xiaoxin guessed that the Six Nations would definitely know about my return. Godora's people have not arrived yet, so there is a high chance that they will contact me and ask for my help. It should be within the next two days.

Sharing the suppressant with the Six Nations would be beneficial to the overall situation. While he did not like the other five nations, if he could preserve the civilization of Blue Star, it would be beneficial as well. In his previous life, Yi Yeqing had only been alone. Now, he had many mercenaries under his command that could cultivate the ingredients for the suppressant. He could get them to help the Six Nations create the suppressant formula, and Sanctuary Three would not stand out too much.

Of course, this would require the Six Nations to take the initiative to look for him for help. If he were to personally help them, it would be too shameful, and the respect the Six Nations had for him would decrease. This was not in line with his plans, and he was confident that the Six Nations would try to look for him.

However, Yi Yeqing's suppressant was not the only method to deal with the Mutation Disaster. Godora was a magic civilization, and they also had similar suppressants. However, they were also in short supply. After all, wasting suppressants to protect billions of unrelated natives was a waste of resources. Furthermore, Godora had to deal with more than one planet.

In the storyline of his previous life, Godora selected targets and gave out suppressants. Most of the refugees did not have the right to use them, and the players could earn money by completing tasks assigned by Godora to buy suppressants. They could then complete some of the refugees' requests and increase the mission progress.

However, with Han Xiao's influence, the production of Emerald Grass' suppressants had increased tremendously. Furthermore, the suppressants were basically given out for free, so Godora's suppressants were no longer as important. Although this did not seem important, it was an extremely important part of Han Xiao's plan.

That was because this involved the change of the currency system.

The Blue Star players used the local currency, which was not recognized in the galaxy. What Han Xiao needed now was Enas, and the players' money came from the NP's missions. They had not connected to the galaxy yet, so they did not have Enas. Thus, Han Xiao's target was Godora.

Godora would give out missions to the players, and the reward would be Enas. The players did not need to buy Godora's suppressants, and they would be able to save money. Seeing that Han Xiao had so many machinery equipment and class advancement knowledge, as well as being able to increase the relationship between factions by spending money, it was clear where the players were more willing to spend their money.

Thus, before Godora arrived, Han Xiao was not prepared to sell any machinery. He would only impart skills and knowledge to earn experience.

Godora still does not know that the Mutation Source is part of Dark-star's scheme. As long as I reveal this, Godora will immediately pay attention and send people over …

As he watched the mages transplant the materials, he stroked his chin and thought of his own plan. Dark-star arranged the Mutation Source for some sort of strategic purpose. As long as Godora does not appear, Dark-star will not appear either. If I inform them to rush over, the battle between the two factions will immediately begin. They are all indirect competitors for my recruitment of players … If I do not inform them, I will seize the opportunity and make use of this time to increase the attractiveness of my faction to the players …

If both sides were to interfere, the official battle would begin. However, before that, it would be beneficial to him. He had also seen the commotion on the forums. Just as he had expected, the influence of his return was slowly fermenting among the players, and it was extremely beneficial.

Han Xiao pondered for a moment and decided not to reveal his information first. He would wait for Godora to come over before revealing it. He had grasped the truth of the Mutation Disaster and the original Mutation Source. He needed to find a good opportunity to hand it over to Godora to maximize his profits. However, now was not the best time, and there was no need to be so anxious.

My goal is to get as many players to join my mercenary group as possible. However, I cannot allow just anyone to join my mercenary group. I have to set a threshold for entry. Otherwise, it will seem like I am not picky. Furthermore, players will not cherish things that are too easy to obtain.

However, I have to consider the number of people, so the threshold for entry has to be moderate. What I can confirm is that many players want to join my faction … It will be best if I can create a competitive situation. After all, the victor will be envied by others, and I will make joining my faction a privilege that only the victor can enjoy. This way, the players will value this opportunity even more.

Han Xiao's eyes turned, and he had a pretty good idea. He remembered it in his heart. Version 2.0 was about to begin, and he had many things to do as well.

However, before implementing these measures, there was something more important that he had to do immediately. That was to harvest a wave of Experience Points and allow his strength to soar once again.

Han Xiao was currently at level 116, and his Experience Points on his interface was less than 100,000,000. He had not leveled up for almost a year, and there were hundreds of blueprints on his Skills Interface. His need for Experience Points was like a ravenous hunger.
